style: Use the attached images ONLY as a STYLE reference for the LINE and the flat playful editorial look — match their bold confident black ink outlines, flat colors with NO gradients and minimal shading. Do NOT copy their colors. Use instead a flat limited PASTEL palette: mint green #B6E5CF, powder blue #AFC9E8, pale butter yellow #F6E7A8, soft blush pink #F6C6DA, and black, on a PLAIN WHITE background. Draw a brand-new illustration in that style.
end: Draw NO people and no faces. Generous empty white space around the subject. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions.

cards.prompt: A round cell cut open like a doll's house, with four or five clearly different pieces of machinery inside it — a big sphere, a bean, a stack of folded sheets, a bag — each a separate shape sitting in its own space. Flat and simple.
A large round nucleus with a double outer wall, coiled threads inside it, and one small ribbon-shaped copy slipping out through a pore in the wall into the space beyond. Flat and simple.
A folded sheet of membrane studded with dozens of tiny two-lobed machines, a few more of them drifting loose above it, and one machine with a short string of beads coming out of it. Flat and simple.

Three bean-shaped bodies with wavy folded inner walls, drawn large, with a small sugar cube and a round bubble of air entering one of them by an arrow and a small battery shape leaving it. Flat and simple.
One bean-shaped body cut open to show a small closed loop of thread inside it and its own scattering of tiny two-lobed machines, drawn apart from the larger cell behind it. Flat and simple.
A handwritten manuscript lying on a desk beside a tall leaning stack of opened return envelopes, with a single fountain pen resting across the top page. Flat and simple.

A simple branching family tree drawn as lines and dots, with a bean-shaped body and a rod-shaped bacterium sitting together on the same small branch, and a green oval leaf-body on a branch beside them. Flat and simple.
Two round cells side by side: the left one holding a large walled sphere at its centre, the right one holding a loose loop of thread and no sphere at all. Flat and simple.
An open window with a curl of air drawn coming through it, the curl travelling down to a single bean-shaped body, and a second curl leaving in the other direction. Flat and simple.
